title: Who Takes the Honey?
offer: Every night, a pot of honey is gone from my hives! Who takes it? Ask Old Halvard the ferryman, he sees everything on the lakes.

steps.say: Honey? Ha! I saw paw prints on the shore by Svanetorp. Small ones. Ask Old Grim there.
Paw prints? Look in my woodshed... a bear cub, sticky with honey! His mother must be in the woods by Hjortingsala. Take him to her, gently.

steps.load_say: He is asleep in the basket. Row quietly!

steps.say: A bear cub! I am not even cross. I will leave a pot of honey at the edge of the woods for him, now and then.

fact: Bears love honey, and the beekeepers of the north built their hives high up.
